outcome: vulnerability in the Early Development Instrument (EDI)
cohort: Children in kindergarten, comprising a population-based cohort born between 2000-2011, and a sibling cohort consisting of preterm children and their closest-in-age full-term siblings.
finding: In a population-based cohort, children born preterm exhibited lower school readiness rates than children born full term, although this difference was not observed in a sibling cohort.
gest_age: Preterm: < 37 weeks (mean [SD] 34 [2] weeks); Full term: mean [SD] 39 (1) weeks
